label: first copy step of length-9 sequences, specific orig(0..2) token combos
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.03% of steps) and fires only in the copy phase, at the step right after <DEL> (t = L+1, recall_idx 1, input = orig(0), output = orig(1)). 96% of activation mass is in L = 9 sequences (t = 10); there are a few weak hits for L = 3 and L = 8. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or at other copy steps. That position (recall_idx==1 & L==9) covers 96% of mass, but only 2% of such steps fire. No single coherent token rule was found.
